name: Nextcloud Cookbook
tagline: Your Nextcloud recipe book, on your phone
description:
If you keep your recipes in the Cookbook app on Nextcloud, this puts the whole collection in your pocket. Browse everything or jump to a category, read a recipe while you cook, and add or edit recipes right from the phone. You can also paste the address of a recipe page from the web and let the app import it for you.

The screen stays awake on a recipe, so it will not go dark halfway through the method with floury hands. Everything lives on your own Nextcloud, so any change shows up on your other devices too.

You need a Nextcloud server with the Cookbook app installed and turned on. There is no offline mode yet, so you have to be able to reach your server to read your recipes.
